web-guide-idea-85.audience: People interested in learning a folk-dance form from home.
web-guide-idea-85.offer: Introduce a particular form with its context and a few accessible movements. Teach what you know accurately.
web-guide-idea-85.steps.0: Name the dance form and explain its setting.
web-guide-idea-85.steps.2: Practise a short sequence and discuss rhythm.
web-guide-idea-85.equipment: A phone with a full-body view, safe clear space and permitted music or rhythm accompaniment.
web-guide-idea-85.returnReason: Explore another step pattern or cultural occasion within the same form.
web-guide-idea-85.promotion: Share a short demonstration and your relevant teaching experience.
web-guide-idea-85.metadataTitle: Folk Dance From Home — Creator Idea & Practical Guide · Saathum
web-guide-idea-85.metadataDescription: Introduce Garba, Bhangra or another folk-dance form through a guided practice session. Learn what to offer, how to start and what equipment you need.
